prompt:
Listen to this {duration:.3f}-second audio. Detect every audible occurrence matching the queries below. Give separate start/end times for separate occurrences, relative to this window. Events may overlap. Do not infer sounds from the scene. Use only listed query_id integers. Return ONLY JSON: {{"events":[{{"query_id":0,"start":0.2,"end":1.3}}]}}. If none are audible, return {{"events":[]}}. Times must satisfy 0 <= start < end <= {duration:.3f}. Do not provide confidence scores. Queries:
{queries}
note: Generated event spans; no native frame scores, PSDS or mpAUC. No GT included in prompts.
